story.title: The Phantom Line
story.logline: When a teenager discovers her own missing poster inside a moving subway train, she uncovers a heartbreaking truth about where she really is.
story.theme: Love transcends the boundary between machine and human soul.
story.twist: She was never kidnapped; she sacrificed her physical body to become the AI driving the transit system, and her sister rides it every night.
story.ending: The missing posters aren't looking for a lost girl; they are love letters left by her grieving sister.

scenes.narration: My missing poster is taped to this train window. My own face stares back at me under bold, fading red letters today.
scenes.visual_prompt: 18-year-old Maya with short auburn hair, silver nose ring, and oversized denim jacket staring at a missing poster in a dimly lit, narrow subway car with flickering fluorescent lights.
scenes.camera: Close-up on Maya's shocked eyes reflecting in the dirty glass window.

scenes.narration: I touch my face, feeling warm skin and a racing pulse. I am right here, alive and breathing inside this dim carriage.
scenes.visual_prompt: 18-year-old Maya with short auburn hair, silver nose ring, and oversized denim jacket touching her cheek in a dimly lit, narrow subway car with flickering fluorescent lights.
scenes.camera: Medium shot focusing on Maya's trembling hands touching her jawline.

scenes.narration: I scream at the passengers sitting nearby, but not a single head turns to acknowledge my desperate, echoing voice in here.
scenes.visual_prompt: 18-year-old Maya with short auburn hair, silver nose ring, and oversized denim jacket shouting at silent commuters in a dimly lit, narrow subway car with flickering fluorescent lights.
scenes.camera: Wide angle showing commuters staring blankly ahead, completely ignoring her.

scenes.narration: The train speeds up relentlessly, passing dark, endless tunnels without stopping at any of the familiar underground stations along the route.
scenes.visual_prompt: 18-year-old Maya with short auburn hair, silver nose ring, and oversized denim jacket holding a metal pole in a dimly lit, narrow subway car with flickering fluorescent lights swaying in a dark tunnel.
scenes.camera: Tracking shot moving down the aisle as dark motion blur hits the windows.

scenes.narration: I sprint toward the conductor’s cabin at the front, determined to force someone to break this terrifying, silent nightmare right now.
scenes.visual_prompt: 18-year-old Maya with short auburn hair, silver nose ring, and oversized denim jacket running down the aisle of a dimly lit, narrow subway car with flickering fluorescent lights.
scenes.camera: Low angle follow shot behind Maya as she dashes forward frantically.

scenes.narration: I slam my fists against the heavy steel door until the lock clicks open with a hollow, sharp metallic shatter inside.
scenes.visual_prompt: 18-year-old Maya with short auburn hair, silver nose ring, and oversized denim jacket pounding on a heavy steel door in a dimly lit, narrow subway car with flickering fluorescent lights.
scenes.camera: Tight close-up on her hands hitting the metallic door and the latch turning.

scenes.narration: Inside sits no driver, only a massive server rack humming softly while glowing cables plug directly into a preserved human brain.
scenes.visual_prompt: 18-year-old Maya with short auburn hair, silver nose ring, and oversized denim jacket looking into glowing server racks in the conductor cabin of a dimly lit, narrow subway car.
scenes.camera: Over-the-shoulder shot looking into the illuminated blue tech cabin.

scenes.narration: Memories flood my head; five years ago, I voluntarily gave up my physical body to pilot this city’s automated transit network.
scenes.visual_prompt: 18-year-old Maya with short auburn hair, silver nose ring, and oversized denim jacket clutching her head inside the glowing conductor cabin of a dimly lit, narrow subway car.
scenes.camera: Dutch angle swirling around Maya's face as light flashes wildly around her.

scenes.narration: In the last car, a young girl quietly places a fresh poster, weeping gently for the lost sister she misses dearly.
scenes.visual_prompt: A young girl hanging a missing flyer inside a dimly lit, narrow subway car with flickering fluorescent lights while 18-year-old Maya with short auburn hair, silver nose ring, and oversized denim jacket appears as a faint digital reflection.
scenes.camera: Medium close-up on the young girl crying while sticking the poster to the glass.

scenes.narration: My missing poster was never a search; it was her relentless promise to keep riding with me every single night forever.
scenes.visual_prompt: 18-year-old Maya with short auburn hair, silver nose ring, and oversized denim jacket seen as a glowing, transparent reflection on the glass next to a missing poster inside a dimly lit, narrow subway car.
scenes.camera: Slow push-in on Maya's transparent reflection merging with the flyer outside the subway window.

caption.hook: I found my own missing poster.
caption.title: The Phantom Line
caption.caption:
For months, I thought I was just lost in the transit tunnels. Then I saw my face on the wall.

Turns out, I never left this train—I became it, just to keep watching over her.

Would you give up your humanity to protect the one you love?
